access.title: Permissions and quotas
access.description: Configure role and per-user feature access, domain permissions, mailbox limits, and send/receive quotas.

quotaGuide.title: How quotas are evaluated
quotaGuide.general: Role and per-user settings control permissions, domains, mailbox count, mailbox lifetime, and message size. Mail-count quotas are managed separately as rules.
quotaGuide.mail: A mail-count rule selects users and one address scope. -1 is unlimited, 0 blocks, and a positive value limits a rolling window.
quotaGuide.enforcement: Permissions and domain access are checked first. One site-wide rule may apply, plus at most one user or role rule (user first); within each layer, mailbox precedes domain, then all domains.

access.selectUserHint: Select a user to configure overrides

userPicker.search: Search name, username, or email as you type

access.emperorLockedHint: This invariant is enforced in both the application and API; even the emperor cannot override it.
access.emperorQuotaEditableHint: Emperor feature access, resource limits, and domain access are locked. Explicit emperor quota rules remain possible. A site-wide rule includes emperors unless its Ignore Emperor usage option is enabled.
access.overrideHint: Items without an override inherit the user's role. Permissions can be explicitly allowed or denied; quotas apply only when enabled.

domains.roleHelp: Controls which domains this role may use to create mailboxes and send or receive mail. Existing mailboxes remain visible.
domains.userHelp: Override the role's domain list for this user. An empty custom list denies every domain without hiding existing mailboxes.
domains.allowAll: Allow all current and future domains
domains.default: Default for unspecified and future domains

success.resetUser: The user now inherits all role defaults

quotas.sectionHelp: These three limits govern mailbox creation and individual inbound message size; they are not daily send/receive counters. Role values are the defaults for users in that role.
quotas.overrideHelp: Enable a field to use a value for this user. A disabled field inherits the role value. Entering 0 explicitly means unlimited; it does not mean inherit.

maxActiveMailboxes.label: Active mailbox limit
maxActiveMailboxes.help: Maximum unexpired mailboxes owned by one user. Expired mailboxes do not consume a slot. 0 means unlimited.

maxMailboxLifetimeDays.label: Maximum mailbox lifetime (days)
maxMailboxLifetimeDays.help: Caps the lifetime selectable when creating a mailbox. 0 allows permanent mailboxes. Existing mailboxes are not shortened when this changes.

maxMessageBytes.label: Maximum inbound message size (bytes)
maxMessageBytes.help: Counts the complete raw message, including headers, body, and encoded attachments. 0 leaves only the system hard limit of 25 MiB.

sendQuota.title: Send quotas
sendQuota.help: The total and per-domain quotas apply together; either one can block a send. Windows are rolling, and one month is defined as 30 days.
sendQuota.userHelp: Unchecked values inherit the role. Once any send quota is overridden, this user is counted independently instead of consuming the shared role quota.

scope.role: Share one quota across the role

mailQuota.title: Mail quota rules
mailQuota.help: A site-wide rule is a true pool shared by all matching users. A role rule can be per member or shared by the role. A one-user rule is always personal.
mailQuota.precedence: The site-wide pool is always enforced. In addition, one user or role rule applies (user first). Within each layer: one mailbox > one domain > all domains.
mailQuota.independent: Each message charges at most one site-wide pool and one user/role pool. Permissions and other resource limits remain independently enforced.
mailQuota.subject: Who is limited

subjects.allHelp: All matching users consume one shared total pool.

mailQuota.ignoreEmperorHelp: When enabled, emperors neither consume nor are limited by this site-wide pool. Otherwise every user is counted.
mailQuota.shareWithinRole: Share the pool within this role
mailQuota.shareWithinRoleHelp: When enabled, role members consume one shared pool. Otherwise each member gets an independent copy of the limit.

targets.allHelp: Counts matching messages for the selected subject across every domain.

mailQuota.duplicate: A rule for the same direction, subject, and range already exists. Edit that rule instead.
mailQuota.empty: No rules for this direction. Matching users are unlimited unless another permission or resource limit denies the operation.

send.title: Send quotas
send.help: Each send consumes all applicable total, sender-domain, and full-mailbox counters. Completed sends and valid in-flight reservations both consume rolling capacity.

receive.title: Receive quotas
receive.help: Before storage, inbound delivery reserves all applicable total, recipient-domain, and full-mailbox quotas. A successful write becomes completed usage; exhaustion at any level rejects that message.

mailQuota.userHelp: Unchecked values inherit the role. Overriding the total or any domain total moves this user's aggregate counters out of the shared role quota. A mailbox-only override keeps aggregate sharing. Mailbox counters are always independent per user and full address.
mailQuota.ruleHelp: -1 = unlimited; 0 = blocked; a positive value is the maximum in the rolling period immediately preceding now. Completed usage and valid in-flight reservations both count.
mailQuota.lifetimeHelp: -1 = unlimited; 0 = blocked; a positive value is the cumulative maximum for this full mailbox since counting began. It does not recover over time; use Reset usage to clear it.
mailQuota.totalHelp: Counts every domain in this direction and applies together with domain and mailbox rules.
mailQuota.mailboxDefaultHelp: Counted separately for each user's full mailbox address. A domain-mailbox or exact-mailbox rule takes precedence when present.
mailQuota.domainsHelp: Without “Limit the domain total,” that domain aggregate is unlimited. Without a mailbox override, the global mailbox default remains in effect. Exact mailbox rules have the highest priority.
mailQuota.domainMailbox: Override every mailbox in this domain

scope.label: Scope for total and domain counters
scope.userHelp: Each role member receives independent total and domain quotas. Mailbox quotas are already always independent.
scope.roleHelp: All role members consume one shared total and per-domain quota, so any member can exhaust it. Mailbox quotas remain independent per user and address.

exact.title: Exact mailbox overrides
exact.help: Optional: give one full mailbox address the highest-priority rolling and lifetime limits. Removing the rule keeps historical counters; reset usage first when they must be cleared.
exact.invalidLocalPart: Use 1–64 letters, numbers, dots, underscores, plus signs, or hyphens

usage.title: Actual usage
usage.help: Current window shows completed messages. In-flight reservations also consume capacity but are listed separately. All-time usage is for audit and is not the current limit.
usage.empty: The selected subject has no effective rule in this direction.
usage.error: Quota usage could not be read or reset. Try again.

reset.title: Reset this quota usage?
reset.description: This permanently deletes completed usage records for the selected subject and direction without changing policy rules. Every overlapping pool backed by the same records changes too. In-flight reservations are preserved.
reset.overlapWarning: Reset deletes underlying completed events, so every site-wide, role, and user pool charged by those messages changes together.
reset.mailboxDescription: This permanently clears the selected direction's rolling and lifetime counters for {address}. Other mailboxes are unchanged.

blocks.title: Mailbox-name blocks
blocks.help: Block a name globally, block one user, or reserve it for the emperor and selected roles. Rules affect only new mailboxes and never delete existing ones.
blocks.invalidLocalPart: Use 1–64 letters, numbers, dots, underscores, plus signs, or hyphens
blocks.rolesHelp: The emperor is always allowed. Select any additional roles that may use this name; selecting none makes it emperor-only.
blocks.search: Search names, users or roles as you type
blocks.rolesScope: Available only to the emperor and: {roles}
blocks.deleteDescription: {address} can be created again by the affected users after removal.

success.fontDescription: The new font now applies to all UI text and editors and will persist across page loads.
success.advancedSavedDescription: Refresh the page to apply it. Use safe appearance mode if the page becomes unusable.

font.title: Site-wide font
font.description: Enter a CSS font-family value. Only safe font names and fallback lists are accepted.

advanced.title: High-risk advanced appearance
advanced.subtitle: Inject CSS, Head HTML, end-of-Body HTML, and JavaScript directly
advanced.emperorOnly: Only an emperor account can edit advanced appearance.
advanced.warningTitle: Injected content runs with the current signed-in user's page privileges
advanced.warningDescription: Malicious HTML or JavaScript can read email, call APIs, or steal page data. Use only code you wrote and fully reviewed; never paste untrusted code.
advanced.enabledDescription: When disabled, saved content is retained but no advanced injection runs on the site.
advanced.customCssHelp: Appended to the end of page styles. You may use @font-face, @import, or override existing selectors.
advanced.customJsHelp: Do not include a <script> tag. Execution must also be enabled separately.
advanced.customJsPlaceholder:
// Runs in the browser
console.log("MoeMail custom appearance")
advanced.safeMode: If custom content makes the page unusable, append ?safe-appearance=1 to any page URL (or &safe-appearance=1 when a query already exists). That request skips all advanced injection so you can clear or fix it here.
advanced.limits: Each input is limited to 128 KiB and the total to 256 KiB. Content is stored in the current database and included in database backups.
advanced.clearDescription: This permanently deletes the saved CSS, HTML, and JavaScript and immediately disables advanced injection.
advanced.saveDescription: This content loads in every visitor's browser. Confirm that you wrote or fully reviewed it, then refresh the page after saving to verify it.
